text:
My go-to place every time I’m in Chiang Mai.
I absolutely love how gentle they are on my skin  their precision, care and professionalism always leave me feeling so fresh.

This time I chose the detox package and wow… my skin feels incredibly clean, smooth, and revived.
Highly, highly recommend

I had an excellent facial cleansing session and couldn’t be happier with the results! The procedure was thorough yet very gentle, and everything was explained clearly throughout the appointment. My skin feels deeply cleansed, smooth, and refreshed. I couldn’t find such perfect results in Europe for a while! The cosmetologist was skilled, caring, and made me feel completely comfortable. She took care as well of ears and neck cleaning, not only my face, and she did a small head and shoulders massage at the end, what felt amazing:) I will definitely be coming back! And highly recommend you!

I had an amazing experience at Reface Santitum Facial and will definitely be back!
The prices are very fair, and the service was outstanding. I ended up running almost an hour late for my appointment, but they were so understanding and still accommodated me without any hassle.
The facial itself was wonderful - they were incredibly gentle throughout the entire treatment, which I really appreciated. The whole experience felt relaxing and professional.
Highly recommend if you’re looking for a quality facial in Chiang Mai at reasonable prices with genuinely kind staff!

Small shop specialized in facials. They have 3 beds so it is best to make an appointment, the listed phone number works on WhatsApp and LINE.
The staff is wonderful and very attentive, the place is impeccably clean with great hygiene measures.
I have asked for extractions and they were able to address a cluster under my chin that no one else could resolve, so incredibly happy with their services!
The products they use are high quality and the customer masks they chose for your skin type are spot on.

Enclosed pictures of their various choices, the packages are the best options.
I cannot imagine going anywhere else!

Excellent facials received here! My mom and I opted for course H, which includes cleansing, blackhead / cebum removal, facial massage, and finishing mask.

The ladies were very kind and made the experience enjoyable. At 490 for the set, it’s a great deal and we will gladly return. They gave us water after, and the bathrooms were clean. Thank you ladies!

Amazing facials! My skin was acting up from all the pollution, dirt, and dust riding the motorbike. I visited this place twice during my stay, and very much enjoyed the service! The facility is relaxing, clean, and comfortable. Both technicians are knowledgeable and friendly. My favorite part of the facial is when they massage your face with ice. It feels incredible! Highly recommend checking this place out.

Highly recommend this place. My skin felt SO clean and soft afterwards. Definitely get one of their options with the steam and vacuum. So great for cleaning out your pores! The environment is very chill and relaxing. I fell asleep while getting my facial!

Had such a positive experience here—special thank you to Anh!! She is not only a wonderful aesthetician with great attention to detail, but she is also very sweet and as a bonus even speaks good english to make skin recommendations for you. Next time I return I will 100% ask for her!
The salon itself is clean and well equipped, and the services are very reasonably priced. Love seeing local businesses really care about what they do. Will absolutely be back, thank you!
very nice people. It has been a few days since i’ve been here and sadly my skin has never been this bad, during the complete treatment I had a-lot of pain it felt like she was cutting in my skin. …

I’ve always had problems with acne even though I’m over thirty now. Whenever I’m in Chiang Mai I always come back for an acne treatment here. The ladies are super professional and way more thorough than in the “posh” and expensive salons back home. Everything is clean and sterile. Totally recommend!

Saw this shop come up again and again on my searches online, and I can understand why! It's not a fancy spa salon, but great service and very reasonable prices! Professional too - they wear a mask, wash hands before touching your face, have a station for you to do your hair after the facial, and even help you reapply sun block??!!
I thought there would be extraction but it's a different service. No complaints though, very pleasant experience for the price.
Do drop them a message on Messenger/WhatsApp before going by as they're quite popular to avoid any disappointment!

This was seriously the best facial I’ve ever had.

I got the ‘special best of maintenance package’ that included cleansing, steam vacuum to remove blackheads, the vitamin cooling facial massage, and mask. The cooling facial massage was INCREDIBLE and the bed was really comfortable. My skin looks so rejuvenated.

The staff is also so kind and genuine. They wished me a happy birthday and even waited in the rainy street with an umbrella for my grab to arrive. I will never forget this experience.

As a loyal and consistently satisfied customer of ReFace for years, it deeply saddens me to see some reviews that are more indicative of unrealistic expectations than of actual services that could be provided by such a small local shop that purports to offer neither the Dermatological nor Plastic Surgical credentials of a certified hospital.  In addition, folks presenting with severe skin issues whether be at this shop or at a hospital cannot sanely expect their conditions to be eradicated immediately!
I stand by my support of the honest and sincere efforts the ladies of ReFace put into each and every service they provide.  As a local, I choose regular visits to this shop exclusively because of the absolutely exceptional value always on offer here.

A perfectly delightful experience, especially for a senior like myself.  K Aun combines focus, experience and compassion into each visit to this tiny oasis in the heart of Santhitam as she considers the unique needs of individual facials for individual needs. The shop is tidy, the music lovely and the staff absolutely wonderful.  Please make sure to call ahead for an appointment so you don’t miss out on this hidden gem!

I usually don’t write reviews, but this is a must.
I had an acne treatment with manual extraction. She did an amazing job. They were both speaking perfectly English, and very caring. During the treatment, she even gave me some head and neck massage.
Of course, the manual extraction was painful  but the red spots soon become less.
I will return for sure! THANK YOU

Don’t go there. Worst facial I had in my life. It was painful from the very beginning, at the point both the professional and the owner were surprised I hadn’t cried and congratulated me. I wanted it to end from the start. They left several marks at my skin. Cheap but the cost afterwards is extremely high.

Lovely facial with really soft and soothing products. My skin typically flares up a little but that was not the case here. The massage was so nice after the cleanse and extractions. The ladies are very kind and friendly. …

Loved this place. Amazing facials and very cheap. Very nice staff. My husband got his first facial and loved it. You can choose from many different options. I had two facials here! Highly recommend this place.

We always enjoy coming here :) We feel so refreshed afterwards, with sparkling clean faces. Very professional and clean. The staff and owner are the nicest people. It's a pleasure to come here. I can highly recommend it to everyone 😊 …

The ladies were so nice and sweet. The lady who did my face was really thorough with the extraction. I think she removed all my blackheads, whiteheads, acne, and all the sins I did in this life and the past

Me and my partner had a great experience here. We both chose package H which included cleansing, blackhead removal, face massage and a face mask.
It was so relaxing I fell asleep. We were treated so well with the ladies letting us know what was going onto our skin at each stage and they clearly had great massaging skills.

We both left with glowing, refreshed skin. Would recommend to anyone!

My friends and I all got facials that included extractions (popping pimples) and it was AMAZING!! The estheticians were soooo thorough and all of us have glowing, smooth skin afterward!! Will definitely be back before we leave Thailand!!

Went for the 750thb option.
Was not disappointed as my I left feeling completely refreshed.

Skin looks and feels much better for it, and the blackhead vac was amazing (plenty got extracted).

Do try and book in advance tho to avoid disappointment.

text:
Looked up this place as im having a bad breakout. The place was clean and well-maintained.

Prices are extremely reasonable. Paid b550 for an acne package which lasted about 1 hour-ish

The therapist was nice and did the facial with soothing strokes. Even the extractions was gently performed.

She will also give u a facial and shoulder massage at the end.

Great value, left with a gently calmed face.

Highly recommend !
I had a great experience here. I asked for the full treatment and I was treated with lots of care. It was affordable, relaxing and my skin liked it.

Absolutely incredible experience!!! Took my boyfriend and we both left flabbergasted at the immediate improvement in our faces 🤩 we left literally GLOWING!! The blackhead suction is effective and not painful. They are meticulous and …
A great, relaxing experience. Very good prices. Calm, clean treatment space. I would definitely recommend this place. You do have to make a reservation beforehand.
My wife has very sensitive skin and came here for a facial treatment that was absolutely perfect. Very attentive and friendly staff who took expert care, highly recommended!
The staff is absolutely lovely, the treatment I received was amazing. The place is also very clean, I really recommend it

I visited the clinic this morning with my partner and were greeted by friendly, smiling staff - and cats!
We both opted for the cleanse, steam and vacuum blackheads, facial massage and the mask. It was all very relaxing especially the massage and we even had a little shoulder, head and arm massage too! I have been suffering with bad acne along my jawline during my backpacking trip but the lovely lady helped advise me on which face mask would best help my skin.
Thank you again so much, we both absolutely loved our treatment and are planning on coming back before we leave Chiang Mai & head home to the UK☺️

This small salon does magic on your face. The 90 minute treatment hydrates my old skin and makes it look healthy and younger. The staff is so accommodating and friendly, it can’t get any better than this.
I was fortunate to get a package deal  for six treatments at a very reasonable price which hooked me on these fabulous facials. They are not too far from Maya Mall, a very convenient location. Try them out, you’ll get hooked too!

The 2 women here went above and beyond. We arrived the night before with out making an appointment. Unfortunately they were all booked up for the evening.
We were leaving the next morning to catch our flight.
They offered to open an hour early the next day to get our facials done.
This is my second time in Chiang Mai and my second visit to this place.
I highly recommend them.
The service is amazing.
They do such a great job.
Price is so affordable and please definitely tip on top of the service. They are worth it.

Just had a facial here. I feel incredible, my skin feels soft and clean. Been suffering from sickness  and this is just what I needed. I highly recommend. Friendly and welcoming staff who made me feel at home. Thanks !

A professional beautician to do the facial treatment.  Feel very  relaxing to  massage the face. I am definitely come back to enjoy the treatment.
Apart from this, the boss is very helpful. We parked our car outside the shop. …

Best facial I ever had after many years. Two lovely ladies. The owner I believe was such a kind fun person that even recommended me good food around the area and the therapist was so gentle and did an amazing job, she took her time to deep clean my face that I even fell asleep. My face feels so clean and refresh after. Thank you so much :))

I managed to get a last minute cancellation appointment opening here. The staff were very friendly and I had the deep clean facial with extraction which is very reasonably priced. I had never had this before but the beautician was very good and thorough. My skin was so much better after. Really recommend this facial and salon. Thank you!

This place was amazing for facials. Everything from start to finish was amazing! The ladies were so kind as well. The facial massage was longer than I expected which was great! I went twice during my week stay in Chiang Mai & highly recommend. You do need to make a reservation in advanced because they do fill up fast! You can do that via WhatsApp!
I had a fantastic experience with the facial! It was incredibly nice and calming, leaving me feeling relaxed throughout. Best of all, my skin looks amazing—clear, refreshed, and glowing.
I was looking for a facial in Chiang Mai that had a great price and hopefully extractions too, as that’s what I get back home. I found this place online and am so happy with my experience! …

I've just had the best face treatment of my life! The lady who took care of my face had magic hands. She did an excellent massage and she put excellent products on my skin. I went out with a very smooth and soft skin. Highly recommended!

I don't do facial often so I can't tell if it is the best. But I do like the staff they are so friendly and like an old friend that you can feel so relaxed with.

The staff seems so skillful and the facial massage feels so good. I was super nervous that the liquid  charcoal mask may spill onto my clothes, but everything was good.

They do have an English menu, and the combo usually costs from 300baht to 750baht.

I like it the staff wears masks when doing the spa and there is still COVID protective screen to separate one bed to the next.
First time having my facial treatment with my wife at Reface.  I always thought that men don’t need to receive facial treatment.  But this process changed my mind. …

I decided to stop by here after doing some research for places in Chiang Mai that do facials. Upon walking in the staff were very friendly and helpful. After looking at a menu I chose a facial cleanse, steam facial, pimple extraction, and a face mask/massage at the end. During my treatment I felt well taken care of & not rushed.

This place is clean & comfortable. And you can’t beat the price! 400baht for everything.

Highly recommend! :)

We are a gay male couple and visited on a Wednesday afternoon with no appointment. As there was already somebody booked- the owner/aesthetician asked us to return in 1.5hours. This js fine as there nearby cafe, massage (SMH school of …

Great service and excellent customer care. I got the complete acne facial treatment and they really cleaned my face and took time to cool it down later with a nice cold & aloe Vera technique.
I will come back next time!

I saw how many great reviews on here so I decided to come here. This place is so good. They best thing about this place is how nice the people are. I love their energy. The service is great and they do a great job as well. Good price for great service and quality.
Went here twice and got deep cleansing facial both times. They are amazing at what they do and extracted all my whiteheads and blackheads. My skin always feel smoother and clearer after each visit.

My friend and I were staying for a few days in Chiang Mai and we felt like trying this place. Everything was perfect. Both workers were extremely nice and the products they use are good quality. I highly recommend this place. Thank you again ❤️

As a first timer, despite the painful acne extractions that I had, it was worth it. Their service on making sure I’m okay at every pinch and scrape was indeed professional and showed me with intense care (because I have low pain tolerance 😆) …

They really took there time and cleaned all my spots well for only 100 bht more. She was being very patient and took a lot of time for me. I am happy with the results. I was a little red after but only for one day. I can recommend this place.
Very thorough facial and such good value!
Excellent
I had the 'Big Clear' treatment. It was really very professional and the staff were extremely friendly.
Thanks for the big clear. Great service and lovely staff.
Excellent service and advice. They were attentive and even applied sunscreen for me. Thank you! I'll definitely come every month if I have the chance.😆 …
Awesome skill and i really feel refresh
Good service and proffessional

I had a very pleasant facial treatment here. The staff are incredibly friendly and you immediately feel at ease. The mask at the end was cooling, and the entire treatment was gentle on my skin. My skin feels wonderfully refreshed and clean.

I had a facial at this salon and the experience was incredible from beginning to end. The staff is very professional, gentle, and attentive. You can tell they have mastered the techniques and truly take the time to care for your skin.

The treatment was extremely relaxing: a facial and shoulder massage, products tailored to my skin type… I left with a radiant complexion, smooth, and ultra-hydrated skin. The place is clean and calming, and the welcome was truly warm.

I wholeheartedly recommend this salon if you're looking for a truly relaxing experience and a high-quality facial in Thailand!
Loved it. So good, so thorough. Probably the best extraction facial I've ever had.
Very nice facial
Amazing staff, rude owner :(
Very good price compare to other places. Many packages to choose from.
The service was excellent.

text: We're on vacation and decided to go to this center for a facial treatment, the H Happy set. We booked an appointment via WhatsApp, and communication was quick and easy. They treated us very well, and their work is very professional. They …

My son said he was sick and crying, but his acne has visibly cleared up! I'm so happy!
The owner and both staff members were incredibly kind!
The prices are cheaper than in Korea, and the acne extraction was really good and effective.
I was very impressed!! Highly recommend!!

Terrible. I would never use their services again. The shop is very old and unclean. To put it simply, it's dirty and substandard. Be careful; you might go for a facial massage but end up with acne instead.
"I parked to buy water at the shop next door, in front of the building that's under renovation. You should know I wasn't blocking their shop at all. Honestly, I could barely see their shop; it's too small. But I can confirm, without a doubt, that I didn't even go near their shop. And where I parked was on a public road. I could have parked in front of your shop, but I didn't. I saw that the building where I parked was covered with netting for renovations.
I mean, I shouldn't have caused anyone any trouble, but I still did. There are no customers, and how are customers going to get to your shop when you've parked your small motorcycle blocking the front of your shop completely? I wish your business continued success."
A wonderful experience! A high-quality and attentive treatment. Soft music. Highly recommended!

I had come across Reface Santitum while traveling abroad, looking for a place that specializes in exfoliation for my acne. ☺️
I received the Acne Big Set, and the therapist did a great job of cleansing, exfoliating, and caring for my acne, so I'm very satisfied!
It's a Korean-style needling and squeezing method, not squeezing, but rather pressing and squeezing, which can be a bit irritating. It also involves pressing and pressing to remove sebum from pores, so I wouldn't recommend it for sensitive skin!
If you don't have acne, the Happy Set might be a good option for you.🌟

I visited this place twice during my trip to Chiang Mai! They're really serious about extrusion. I've been to many dermatologists and skin care shops, but this is the first time they did such thorough extrusion. My skin feels so soft and …

I got the Big Clear set for 550 baht! It was affordable, the space was clean, the staff was friendly, and the care was incredibly thorough.
My skin isn't great, lol. I have a lot of small acne breakouts... In Korea, dermatologists don't do full-face treatments like this, but they thoroughly extracted every last pimple without fail. (It really hurt...ㅠㅠ)
Afterward, they gave me a mask and water. They were super friendly. They even have a cute cat. They accept GLN payments. Apparently, you have to make a reservation beforehand! I made my reservation via WhatsApp, and they responded quickly. 👍

Superb welcome and a wonderful facial! I had a great time. Thank you for your hospitality 🫶
I chose treatment E, which was very comprehensive. …
I loved it! The facial scrub program is customizable to my skin type. The price is reasonable, it's clean, and the owner is lovely and kind.
